profile.headline: Software Engineer @ NYSIF | App Dev, Web Expert
profile.summary: With a solid track record as Full-stack Developer at New York State Insurance Fund and prior lead role at Truist, my expertise is in crafting cutting-edge web applications that drive efficiency and innovation. Proficient in application and web development, my mission is to elevate the digital landscape through robust, user-centric solutions. At NYSIF, my focus is on leveraging my competencies to align with the organization's goals, bringing diverse perspectives to the team, and contributing to a culture of excellence.
